questions.q: Which of these is a container platform route (as opposed to a managed ML endpoint) mentioned in the lesson?
options: Azure Machine Learning batch endpoints
SageMaker asynchronous endpoints
Google Cloud Run
A Jupyter notebook kernel
questions.explain: Cloud Run, Azure Container Apps, and ECS with Fargate run general container images; Azure ML and SageMaker endpoints are ML-platform-specific.

questions.q: Why deploy an exact version tag such as churn-service:1.0.0 instead of latest?
options: Because latest is not allowed in any registry
So you always know exactly which image and model version is running and can roll back to a known one
Because version tags make the model more accurate
Because platforms require numeric tags to start
questions.explain: A moving tag hides what is actually deployed. Exact tags give traceability and reliable rollbacks.

questions.q: What is the trade-off of letting a model service scale to zero instances?
options: It saves cost when idle but the first request may wait for a cold start while the model loads
It makes the model less accurate
It prevents logging
It doubles the cost per request
questions.explain: With no running instance, the platform must start a container and load the model before answering, so measure and decide whether that delay is acceptable.

questions.q: What does a good post-deploy smoke test in this lesson check?
options: Only that the container image is small
The health endpoint, then a known golden input returns the expected score within a tolerance
That the training data is unchanged
That the Dockerfile has a comment on every line
questions.explain: Checking health and a golden prediction confirms both that the service is up and that it still produces the validated model's answer.

questions.q: What is the safest way to roll out a new model version?
options: Replace the old version everywhere at once
Delete the old version first to avoid confusion
Deploy it beside the old one, smoke test it, shift a small share of traffic, and keep rollback one step away
Ask users to test it and report bugs
questions.explain: Gradual traffic shifting limits the damage of a bad version, and being able to shift traffic back makes rollback fast.
